limitations: This is source provenance and midpoint construction data, not a certified remesh.
Path uniqueness is not required; near-equal shortest paths are recorded and resolved deterministically by stable NHSKIN row ID.
Normal compatibility is a local orientation consistency check, not anatomical truth or full face correspondence.
I/D values are endpoint-field interpolants only; all resulting cells, materials, mass, bone clearance, mapped detail, and self-intersection require independent gates.

method.W_semantics: W is a displacement prolongation operator only; midpoint weights are recorded as displacement support, not absolute-position barycentrics
method.donor_filter: both detail_donor_body and transfer_donor_body at every path vertex must belong to the union of endpoint anchor donor IDs
method.edge_population: unique baseline-103 O-O crossing edges on the actual source O boundary; two internal O-O volume chords are excluded
method.midpoint: half arclength along selected detailed path; I/D field positions are interpolated from existing corresponding source endpoint rows at the same normalized path fraction 0.5; no thickness/depth is fabricated
method.normal_gate: oriented fine face normals must have positive cosine to their supported source O parent face; detail endpoint area-weighted normals must have positive cosine to coarse O vertex one-ring normals
method.path_choice: shortest edge-length path; deterministic heap ordering and predecessor tie-break by NHSKIN row ID; up to two shortest paths within 1e-12m are reported as ambiguity, not silently hidden
method.path_graph: NHSKIN payload face edges whose W displacement supports are subsets of one of the two exact source O parent faces; active transfer rows are restricted to those selected parent faces plus unique one-hot endpoint anchors

scope: One deterministic source-supported path/midpoint proposal per baseline exact-crossing O-O outer-shell edge; exact NHSKIN source-face graph and typed donor restrictions. No geometry is changed and no surface/volume or physical gate is claimed.
